what: Arena layout migration: every upload keeps games/, snapshots/ and checks/ only; the label route is renamed v04; snapshots left under unknown/ join their registered upload. Every file's SHA-256 checked before and after; no network calls. Script: docs/data/arena-layout-2026-11-04/migrate.py.
mapping: A file at the top of an upload directory -> checks/<filename>; unknown/<league>/agent-<id>/snapshots/<path> -> the agent's registered upload snapshots/<path>; replays/arena/route -> replays/arena/v04.
digestDefinition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines sorted by filename: filename + space + sha256 + LF.
digestNote: Every upload's digest is the same after the move except v03/bronze/upload-03, which gains the two snapshots of unknown/bronze/agent-6829912 (66 -> 68 files); the 2738 file hashes under replays/arena are the same set before and after. Checked afterwards: every game of every manifest (1310) at its manifest's rawDirectory with its sha256.
